name: limit_union_of_bodies_that_do_not_touch
why: ENTRY Z-C18. The guard «the union left two bodies» compared two different enums and could not fire. Before repairing it we measured what SOLIDWORKS does with two bodies that do not touch (25/9/2026, two cubes 10 to 50 mm from each other): the feature IS NOT BORN, and the operation refuses before reaching the guard. This case fixes that refusal: if one day SOLIDWORKS created the feature without fusing, the refusal should come from the repaired guard, with another sentence — and the case would say so.

steps._why_the_main_one: To resemble the twin without being a copy of it: with the same arguments as «requested_combine» the difference would lie only in the geometry, which the comparison of the twins does not see. The main body named by name does not change the union.
